summary:
w142 review: one commit 9b306a9, which is the implementer's 1fed48e rebased with identical content. It changes only skills/delivering-an-initiative/SKILL.md (+4/-4).
Answers are appended as one line to .shop/work/<initiative>/ledger.md with `work note`. The skill stops on a refused note (r7). The archive step of retired r16 is removed. 'ruling' becomes 'answer'. Red Flags now also allow the commit `work note` makes.
This conforms to delivery#r15, decisions 0064, 0066 and 0068, and the plan. It adds no `work answer` call, as delivery's Not yet requires.
No test, feature, script or spec changed. Allowances: none. tools check: ruff and vulture have nothing to check, and the project states no import contracts. size: nothing over 300.
No findings. Cannot verify: a guarantees line with no scenario is judged by the skill's text only.
